description: Spectacled and packed for the long route, the Courier delivers Foxwatch orders by paper glider — faster than any runner, quieter than any drone.
name: The Dispatch — Foxwatch Courier

description: Freckled from seasons in the comb-fields, the Keeper guards the Foxwatch honey stores. The leaf-veined tail marks every keeper since the first hive.
name: The Keeper — Foxwatch Apiary

description: Every evening the Sentinel takes the west post as the light turns to honey. Nothing has ever crossed the line on their watch.
name: The Golden Hour — Foxwatch Sentinel

description: Cut at hard angles and twice as sharp, the Shard leads the vanguard charge. The blue confetti marks a celebration that hasn't happened yet.
name: The Shard — Foxwatch Vanguard
